newsitem.title: USA: Designs Inc Nov same store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Designs Inc Nov same store sales fall.

text.p: Designs Inc said Thursday that sales for the four weeks ended November 30 decreased 11 percent to $26.1 million, compared with sales of $29.2 million in the corresponding period of the prior year.
For the 10 months in the year-to-date period ended November 30, sales decreased 4 percent to $236.8 million, compared with sales of $245.8 million in the prior year period.

Comparable store sales decreased 8 percent for the month of November and decreased 6 percent for the year-to-date period. Comparable stores are retail locations that are open at least 13 months. Of the 150 stores that Designs, Inc. operated as of November 30, comparable stores totaled 140.
